card.name: Mid-drug-name and dose-limit phrasing
card.fires_on: Partway through drug names such as cyclosporine, busulfan and eslicarbazepine, and on small words in phrases about what can be given or monitored ("safely", "well", "the", "be"). Appears in drug-level monitoring and tolerability text.

modes.description: Small adverb or linking word in sentences about doses that can be given or concentration monitoring.
modes.example: The maximum dose of IMLYGIC that can be<< safely>> administered has not been determined.

modes.description: A digit starting a plasma concentration threshold.
